ActionDescriptions.ToAddGitHubCommitComment:
to add github commit comment
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. commitSha - commit SHA. commentBody - comment text. agentSessionName - originating agent session name.
ActionDescriptions.ToAddGitHubIssueComment:
to add github issue comment
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. issueNumber - issue number. commentBody - comment text. agentSessionName - originating agent session name.
ActionDescriptions.ToCheckGitHubOrgAccess:
to check github organization access
orgName - GitHub organization name. Returns access status for the organization.
ActionDescriptions.ToCloseGitHubIssue:
to close github issue
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. issueNumber - issue number to close.
ActionDescriptions.ToCommitAndPushScopedChanges:
to commit and push scoped changes
startPath - path inside a git repository. pathspec - scoped pathspec. commitMessage - commit message. remote - remote name.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateGitHubIssue:
to create github issue
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. title/body - issue content. labelsCsv/assigneesCsv - comma-separated labels and assignees. agentSessionName - originating agent session name.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreatePrivateGitHubRepoInOrg:
to create a private github repository in an organization
orgName - GitHub organization name. repoName - repository name to create as private.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitCurrentBranch:
to get git current branch
startPath - path inside a git repository. Returns the current branch.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitDiff:
to get git diff
startPath - path inside a git repository. target - revision to compare with, default HEAD. maxLines - maximum output lines, default 500.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitHeadSha:
to get git head sha
startPath - path inside a git repository. Returns the current HEAD SHA.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitHubAuthStatus:
to get github auth status
Returns the current GitHub authentication status.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitHubCommitComments:
to get github commit comments
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. commitSha - commit SHA to read comments for.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitHubIssue:
to get github issue
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. issueNumber - issue number to read.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitLog:
to get git log
startPath - path inside a git repository. maxEntries - maximum commits, default 10 and maximum 100.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitRepoRoot:
to get git repository root
startPath - path inside a git repository. Returns the repository root.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitShow:
to get git show
startPath - path inside a git repository. commitSha - commit or revision to show. maxLines - maximum output lines, default 500.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetGitStatusPorcelain:
to get git status porcelain
startPath - path inside a git repository. pathspec - scoped pathspec for status.
ActionDescriptions.ToGitAddPathspec:
to git add a pathspec
startPath - path inside a git repository. pathspec - scoped pathspec to stage.
ActionDescriptions.ToGitCommit:
to git commit staged changes
startPath - path inside a git repository. message - commit message.
ActionDescriptions.ToGitPushBranch:
to git push branch
startPath - path inside a git repository. remote - remote name. branch - branch to push.
ActionDescriptions.ToInitializeAndPushSolutionRepository:
to initialize and push solution repository
solutionDirectory - local solution directory. solutionName/repositoryName/organizationName identify the solution and GitHub repository. cloneUrl - repository clone URL. branchName - branch to initialize and push.
ActionDescriptions.ToListGitHubIssues:
to list github issues
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. state, labelsCsv, and assignee filter returned issues.
ActionDescriptions.ToListGitHubReposForOrg:
to list github repositories for an organization
orgName - GitHub organization name. Returns repositories available for the organization.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunGitTagReleaseInSolution:
to run git tag release in solution
solutionDirectory - solution directory. tagName - release tag to create and push.
ActionDescriptions.ToUpdateGitHubIssue:
to update github issue
orgName/repoName - repository owner and name. issueNumber - issue number. title/body update content. addLabelsCsv/addAssigneesCsv add labels and assignees.
